title: VW's ID. Era 5S sedan, built in China for China with VW's most advanced automated-driving system, reflects China's rise as a source of cutting-edge auto tech
html:
This is a Techmeme archive page. It shows how the site appeared at 4:20 AM ET, November 25, 2026.

summary: Bloomberg : VW's ID. Era 5S sedan, built in China for China with VW's most advanced automated-driving system, reflects China's rise as a source of cutting-edge auto tech — Developers in the world's biggest auto market are building the software and cars VW needs to better compete globally.
